name: Intent spike handler — route and action

nodes.name: Webhook — Intent Spike Ingest
nodes.notes: Accepts POSTs from Common Room outgoing webhooks (organization payload) OR from the Polling Cron's self-POST for 6sense/Bombora CRM-synced data. Path: /webhook/intent-spike-handler.

nodes.name: Respond 202 Accepted
nodes.notes: Return immediately so Common Room or the cron caller is not blocked on downstream enrichment and LLM calls.

nodes.name: Normalize Intent Payload
nodes.notes: Handles Common Room, 6sense CRM-sync, Bombora CRM-sync, and generic shapes. Throws if domain is missing.

nodes.name: Dedup Check — Fetch Static Data
nodes.notes: Reads n8n static workflow data to check if this domain was already actioned today (day-level dedup window). A 404 means first spike of the day — proceed. A 200 means duplicate — skip. Requires N8N_API_KEY env var.

nodes.name: Dedup Gate
nodes.notes: Returns empty array (halts execution) for duplicate spikes. Passes through on first spike of the day. Day-level window prevents SDR fatigue from the same account re-spiking within a single day.

nodes.name: Dedup Mark — Write Static Data
nodes.notes: Stamps this domain+date key as processed so subsequent spikes today are dropped by the Dedup Gate.

nodes.name: Salesforce — Account Lookup
nodes.notes: Looks up the Salesforce Account by domain substring. Returns OwnerId, Owner.Name, Owner.Email, Owner.Slack_Handle__c so the assignment logic can use the existing owner. neverError so a miss flows through.

nodes.name: Assignment Logic
nodes.notes: Priority: SFDC existing owner → territory pool (AMER/EMEA/ROW). urgency flag set on high-severity spikes. All env vars have fallback strings so the flow never throws on missing config.

nodes.name: Claude — Draft First Touch
nodes.notes: 8s timeout. neverError so a Claude failure doesn't block the Slack notification and Salesforce task. Draft is a starting point — explicit in both the system prompt and the Slack message.

nodes.name: Parse Draft (with fallback)
nodes.notes: Tags draftSource as 'claude' or 'template-fallback' so ops can audit how often Claude is actually running.

nodes.name: Slack — Notify Assignee
nodes.notes: Posts to #intent-spikes (all spikes) and @-mentions the assignee's Slack handle if populated. Red circle for high severity, yellow for mid/low.

parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "Subject": "Intent spike: {{ $json.sfdcAccountName }} — {{ $json.spikeSeverity }} severity",
  "Description": "Source: {{ $json.source }}\nBuying stage: {{ $json.buyingStage || 'n/a' }}\nIntent score: {{ $json.intentScore !== null ? $json.intentScore : 'n/a' }}\nTop topics: {{ $json.topTopics.join(', ') }}\nDraft subject: {{ $json.draftSubject }}\nDraft body: {{ $json.draftBody }}\nTalking point: {{ $json.draftTalkingPoint }}\nDraft source: {{ $json.draftSource }}\nAssignment: {{ $json.assignmentSource }}",
  "OwnerId": "{{ $json.sfdcAccountId ? $json.assigneeEmail : '' }}",
  "WhatId": "{{ $json.sfdcAccountId || '' }}",
  "Priority": "{{ $json.isUrgent ? 'High' : 'Normal' }}",
  "Status": "Not Started",
  "ActivityDate": "{{ $now.plus({days: $json.isUrgent ? 1 : 3}).toFormat('yyyy-MM-dd') }}",
  "Type": "Call",
  "Intent_Spike_Source__c": "{{ $json.source }}",
  "Intent_Score__c": {{ $json.intentScore || 'null' }},
  "Intent_Buying_Stage__c": "{{ $json.buyingStage || '' }}"
}

nodes.name: Salesforce — Create Task
nodes.notes: Creates a Salesforce Task on the Account (WhatId). Due date: +1 day for urgent, +3 days for standard. Three custom fields (Intent_Spike_Source__c, Intent_Score__c, Intent_Buying_Stage__c) must be created before activating — see _README.md.

nodes.name: Polling Cron — Every 4h
nodes.notes: Polls Salesforce every 4 hours for accounts whose 6sense or Bombora fields have changed since the last poll window. Forwards spikes to the main webhook. Timezone: America/New_York — adjust to match business hours.

nodes.name: Salesforce — Poll Intent Fields
nodes.notes: Queries Accounts modified in the last 4h with Decision/Purchase buying stage (6sense) OR high Bombora surge. Requires the 6sense and Bombora managed packages to have synced their fields to Account objects. LIMIT 200 per poll — extend query with pagination if volume is higher.

nodes.name: Build Forward Payloads
nodes.notes: Converts each Account record into a payload shaped for the Normalize Intent Payload node. Prefers 6sense fields; falls back to Bombora fields.

nodes.name: Forward to Ingest Webhook
nodes.notes: Sends each Account spike to the main webhook with batchSize 3, batchInterval 3000ms to avoid hammering Anthropic and Salesforce APIs. neverError so one bad forward doesn't stop the batch.
